discoveries: Untranslated manner word(s): control, room. They map to no decisions in the direction vocabulary, so they were recorded rather than guessed at.
Runtime resolution: Calm technical: generous whitespace, quiet labels, tabular numerals for telemetry. Telemetry rewards calm scanning over shouting; restraint here is functional, not decorative.
Readable-numeral decision: tabular numerals for the 4 numeric readout item(s).

Type-role contract: the screen name takes the title role, the decision context takes the subtitle, each information item takes its natural role (eyebrow for metadata, label for chrome-ish captions, body for prose, code for identifiers), and status states take the label role at legible size.

Acceptance criteria declared: no label below 11px; uppercase reserved for eyebrows; one spacing rhythm step between sibling regions; body columns around 75 characters. Measured on rendered evidence when screenshot critique runs (issue #22 phase 2).
Composition archetype contract: workspace (planner runs after this and derives regions; the plan is reviewed against this contract).

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Outranked on the weighted total (6.12 vs 6.48). a story over time must keep its order visible; a grid erases exactly what the brief is about (monitor decision, throughput now,latency p99 now,error rate trend,per-node pressure by resource,stream queue depth,shard health now,recent interventions item(s)). taskFit: 7 — ranked affinity for the 'monitor' decision class. informationHierarchy: 9 — 7 information item(s) against a family that packs them into comparable columns and rows. densityScanability: 7 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: rows/columns absorb inventory.

Outranked on the weighted total (6 vs 6.48). when how things connect is the decision, the connections must be drawn, not described in rows (monitor decision, throughput now,latency p99 now,error rate trend,per-node pressure by resource,stream queue depth,shard health now,recent interventions item(s)). taskFit: 6 — ranked affinity for the 'monitor' decision class, plus the brief's stated relationships that this family draws. relationshipClarity: 9 — 2 stated relationship item(s): 'latency p99 now', 'per-node pressure by resource' — drawn, not listed. informationHierarchy: 8 — 7 information item(s) against a spatial field: dense past ~8 nodes, individual labels stop being readable in place. densityScanability: 6 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: spaced nodes need room per label.

Outranked on the weighted total (6 vs 6.48). arranging or locating things is itself the task, so the composition has to be a place rather than a list (monitor decision, throughput now,latency p99 now,error rate trend,per-node pressure by resource,stream queue depth,shard health now,recent interventions item(s)). taskFit: 6 — ranked affinity for the 'monitor' decision class, plus the brief's stated relationships that this family draws. relationshipClarity: 9 — 2 stated relationship item(s): 'latency p99 now', 'per-node pressure by resource' — drawn, not listed. informationHierarchy: 8 — 7 information item(s) against a spatial field: dense past ~8 nodes, individual labels stop being readable in place. densityScanability: 6 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: spaced nodes need room per label.

Outranked on the weighted total (5.76 vs 6.48). an inventory of comparable things reads fastest as rows, which is the shape a listing already has (monitor decision, throughput now,latency p99 now,error rate trend,per-node pressure by resource,stream queue depth,shard health now,recent interventions item(s)). taskFit: 5 — ranked affinity for the 'monitor' decision class. informationHierarchy: 9 — 7 information item(s) against a family that packs them into comparable columns and rows. densityScanability: 7 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: rows/columns absorb inventory.

Outranked on the weighted total (5.5 vs 6.48). comparing needs both things on screen at once and aligned, or the comparison collapses into memory (monitor decision, throughput now,latency p99 now,error rate trend,per-node pressure by resource,stream queue depth,shard health now,recent interventions item(s)). taskFit: 5 — ranked affinity for the 'monitor' decision class. informationHierarchy: 8 — 7 information item(s) against a family that aligns fewer, taller columns. densityScanability: 6 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: rows/columns absorb inventory.

Disqualified: taskFit scored 3/10, at or below the 3/10 floor. when the brief has one thing to say, the composition must say it first — air, scale and a single focal region (monitor decision, throughput now,latency p99 now,error rate trend,per-node pressure by resource,stream queue depth,shard health now,recent interventions item(s)). taskFit: 3 — ranked affinity for the 'monitor' decision class. informationHierarchy: 4 — 7 information item(s) against a single-focus read: past a handful, the focus is a claim, not a fact. densityScanability: 6 — how 7 item(s) sit in this family: a focused read needs few items to stay a read.
